item.title: 8 New TV Shows to Watch This Weekend on Netflix, HBO, and Hulu (October 23-25)
item.description: Happy weekend! It’s a slow week for TV releases. Over the past month, shows like Carrie , Crystal Lake , and VisionQuest dropped, keeping many viewers busy. But things are picking up soon. In the coming months, we’ll have the return of the final season of Yellowjackets, the third season of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power , and more.

item.title: Esper locations in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.description: Final Fantasy Resonance 's Espers give Fina an extra edge in combat, or sometimes they're just convenient decoys to bait the enemy into attacking them and not your party. However you use them, Espers are definitely worth the MP it costs to summon them. You have to put in some extra work to obtain them, though. Espers are tucked away in different spots around Resonance 's world, and you have to find and often fight them before Fina can use their powers.

item.title: Mass Effect 5 Pitched as 'John Wick and James Bond' in Space, Report Says
item.description: More details keep emerging about Mass Effect: Universe , the planned fifth mainline entry in the Mass Effect franchise that BioWare was developing before EA closed the studio on Wednesday. EA laid off BioWare staff and canceled what fans have long called Mass Effect 5 . An internal trailer using pre-production assets emerged the next day, offering fans a look at what could have been, including potentially the series' first male Quarian squadmate .

item.title: Best Visions to use in Final Fantasy Resonance
item.description: There's so many to choose from that deciding on the best Visions in Final Fantasy Resonance often feels more than a little overwhelming. While every Vision has something that makes them worth using in certain circumstances, there is a set of them that excels in practically every situation. And you can find most of them early in the game, too.

item.title: All 23 BioWare Games, Ranked
item.description: Every great BioWare story starts the same way: You gather a party. For thirty years, the studio gave us companions we’d follow anywhere, choices that kept us up at night, and worlds we didn’t want to leave, from Candlekeep to the Citadel to Thedas. On Oct. 21, EA announced it’s closing BioWare , so we’ve ranked all 23 of its games — including remasters and mobile and browser spin-offs (but not expansions) — from worst to best. Grab your party. We’ll start with the footnotes and work our way up to the legends.

item.title: 4 Years Ago, 'Doctor Who’s Biggest Failure Was Just the Beginning of the End
item.description: As the longest-running sci-fi show in history, Doctor Who has always placed a tremendous responsibility on whoever takes on the role of the Doctor. For Jodie Whittaker, who debuted as the Thirteenth Doctor in 2017, that responsibility carried extra weight: she was the first woman to play the Doctor, a milestone that immediately stirred up the internet’s worst grifters.

item.title: Taylor Sheridan's Call of Duty Adaptation Will Have 'Soul,' Director Says
item.description: Before creating the sprawling Yellowstone franchise and dad-drama series Landman for Paramount, writer Taylor Sheridan cut his teeth on cinematic action thrillers like Sicario , Hell or High Water , and Without Remorse , the latter of which is based on Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six precursor. Sheridan's next big project is an adaptation of Activision's Call of Duty franchise, and he's teaming up with a director who's perfect to tackle the project: Peter Berg, the director behind modern military movies The Kingdom and Lone Survivor .

item.title: Where to find the Netshin Tech Complex in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: The Netshin Tech Complex in DMZ in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is one of the most fortified areas in the game, and for good reason. It contains plenty of high-tier loot, will usually have a lieutenant inside, often has commanders in the general vicinity, and you'll even need to go here for missions at one point.
